edges.description: Count Geonor sentences the Exile to death during his reign of terror in Ogham.

sources.locator: Prelude > Count Geonor

edges.description: The Executioner attempts to hang the Exile, who escapes by jumping into the ocean.

sources.locator: Prelude > Count Geonor

edges.description: The Bloated Miller is the diseased boss the Exile must slay on The Riverbank.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss = The Bloated Miller / Walkthrough 'Slay the Bloated Miller'

edges.description: Renly, the Clearfell blacksmith, rewards the Exile with an Uncut Skill Gem for slaying the Miller.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Talk to the Blacksmith' / 'Take Renly's reward'

edges.description: Una advises that only ancient runes can break the Count's binding on the Hooded One and later speaks to the Exile after his release.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Ask Una for help' / 'Speak to Una'

edges.description: Renly forges the three Runes of Power into Rune Spikes.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Bring the Runes to Renly' / 'Take the Rune Spikes from Renly'

edges.description: The Rust King guards the final Rune of Power in the Red Vale and is defeated for it.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Defeat the Rust King'

edges.description: The Hooded One is released from the Tree of Souls when the Rune Spikes are stabbed into the runes.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Use the Rune Spikes' / 'Speak to Una' (Una: 'He's unconscious, but he's breathing')

edges.description: Una revives the Hooded One at Clearfell Encampment after the Exile brings Count Lachlann's Ring.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Bring Count Lachlann's Ring to Una' / 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One'

edges.description: Una uses Count Lachlann's ring to heal the Hooded One and learns the Seed of Corruption is the cause of Ogham's affliction.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One' (Una: 'You found the ring!')

edges.description: The Hooded One is revived and warns that the Seed of Corruption must be put back.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One' (The Hooded One quote)

edges.description: Lachlann of Endless Lament asks the Exile for the Memorial Gate keys and is put to rest at the end of the quest.

sources.locator: Quest header 'start = Talk to Lachlann the Lost' / 'End Lachlann's Suffering'

edges.description: Asinia, the Praetor's Consort, is destroyed in the Tomb of the Consort for her Memorial Key piece.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Destroy Asinia, the Praetor's Consort'

edges.description: Praetor Draven is destroyed in the Mausoleum for his Memorial Key piece.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Destroy Praetor Draven'

edges.description: The Executioner is the boss the Exile kills at Ogham Village.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss = The Executioner / Walkthrough 'Kill the Executioner'

edges.description: Leitis, the Executioner's prisoner, is freed and asks the Exile to depose Count Geonor.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Free the Prisoner' / 'Talk to Leitis' (Leitis: 'He killed Eamon.')

edges.description: Count Geonor, the Mad Wolf, is the boss the Exile slays in Ogham Manor.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss = Count Geonor / Walkthrough 'Kill the Mad Wolf'

edges.description: Oriana, The Countess, escapes Ogham Manor with the Beast.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Return to Town' ('Oriana has escaped with the Beast')

edges.description: The fledgling Beast escapes Ogham Manor with Oriana, leaving corruption in its wake.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Return to Town' / Hooded One quote ('The fledgling Beast is leaving Corruption in its wake')

edges.description: Leitis sends the Exile into the Manor to find a way in and depose Count Geonor.

sources.locator: Quest header 'start = Talk to Leitis' / Walkthrough 'Infiltrate the Manor'

edges.description: The Hooded One sends the Exile east in pursuit of Oriana and the Beast.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Return to Town' / 'Travel East'

edges.description: Zarka grants the Exile passage as a jingakh and the quest ends on entering the Ardura Caravan.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Enter the Ardura Caravan' / Quest Complete

edges.description: Zarka, leader of the Ardura caravan, asks the Exile to clear the raiders and then admits them as a jingakh.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Earn passage on the caravan' / 'Speak to Zarka'

edges.description: Rathbreaker, leader of the Sun Clan hyenas, is the boss the Exile defeats.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss = Rathbreaker / Walkthrough 'Defeat Rathbreaker'

edges.description: The Hooded One sends the Exile to find a Maraketh caravan to aid the pursuit of the Seed of Corruption.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Speak to the Hooded One' (Hooded One quote on the Maraketh caravan)

edges.description: Rudja, the Dread Engineer, is defeated in Mawdun Mine.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Rudja, Dread Engineer'

edges.description: Risu, a Faridun defector, is found in Mawdun Mine and taken back to the caravan, where she reveals Jamanra's plan to feed the Beast Deshar's honoured dead.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Talk to the Defector' / 'Return to the Caravan's lead cart' (Risu quote)

edges.description: The Faridun run a foundry in Mawdun Mine, where Rudja is defeated.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Investigate Mawdun Mine' ('a foundry run by the Faridun')

edges.description: Sekhema Asala fights alongside the Exile to open the Halani Gates.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Assist Asala in opening the Gates' / 'Open the third Gate'

edges.description: Jamanra, the Risen King, leads the Faridun defending the Gates and is fought there.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Defeat Jamanra, the Risen King'

edges.description: The Exile enters the sand-buried city of Keth and reaches its Sanctum for the Essence of Water.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Search for the Buried Shrines' / 'Find the Sanctum at the heart of Keth'

edges.description: Azarian, the Forsaken Son, is the unique boss the Exile must defeat to reach the Essence of Water.

sources.locator: Quest infobox / Walkthrough 'Defeat Azarian, the Forsaken Son'

edges.description: The Water Goddess Halani asks the Exile to burn her with the Everburning Cinders to end her suffering.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Talk to the Water Goddess' / 'End the Water Goddess' suffering'

edges.description: Asala sends the Exile after the sandstorm to recover the Essence of Water for the Horn.

sources.locator: Quest header 'start = Speak to Sekhema Asala after encountering the sandstorm at the Halani Gates'

edges.description: Ekbab, Ancient Steed, guards the Mastodon Tusks in the Bone Pits and is defeated.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Defeat Ekbab, Ancient Steed and Iktab, the Deathlord'

edges.description: Iktab, the Deathlord, assists Ekbab in the Bone Pits and is defeated.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Defeat Ekbab, Ancient Steed and Iktab, the Deathlord'

edges.description: Zarka receives the Mastodon Tusks for safekeeping at the Ardura Caravan and gives the reward.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Talk to Zarka' / 'Take the Reward'

edges.description: Zalmarath, the Colossus, is defeated at the Rite of Flame in the Titan Grotto and drops the Flame Ruby.

sources.locator: Quest infobox boss = Zalmarath, the Colossus / Walkthrough 'Defeat Zalmarath, the Colossus and retrieve the Flame Ruby'

edges.description: Zarka receives the Flame Ruby at the Ardura Caravan and rewards the Exile.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Take the Flame Ruby to town' / 'Take the reward from Zarka'

edges.description: Asala starts the quest after the sandstorm encounter at the Halani Gates.

sources.locator: Quest header 'start = Speak to Sekhema Asala after encountering the sandstorm at the Halani Gates'

edges.description: Zarka reforges the Horn of the Vastiri with the Exile from the Flame Ruby, Essence of Water and Mastodon Tusks.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Recreate the Horn of the Vastiri' / 'Take the Horn of the Vastiri' (Zarka quote)

edges.description: Asala explains Orbala's footsteps and that the Horn can be recreated by retracing them in any order.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Asala' ('We can retrace Orbala's steps in any order.')

edges.description: Asala speaks to the Exile after the Horn dispels the sandstorm and grants access to Deshar.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Asala' ('I am hesitant to allow you access to sacred Deshar')

edges.description: Tor Gul, the Defiler, is the boss defeated on the way to the Spires of Deshar.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Tor Gul, the Defiler'

edges.description: Tor Gul, the Defiler, is met on the way to the Spires of Deshar, after the Exile travels the Path of Mourning.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Travel through the Path of Mourning' / 'Defeat Tor Gul, the Defiler' (page does not state the fight location)

edges.description: The Faridun, having escaped with the Beast, are defended by Tor Gul.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Defeat Tor Gul, the Defiler' ('The Faridun have escaped with the Beast.')

edges.description: Jamanra, the Abomination, is the boss fought on the Dreadnought.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination' (phase 1 and phase 2)

edges.description: Asala beheads Jamanra in phase 2 after he is reduced to 1 life, ending the fight.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination' ('In Phase 2 ... interact with Sekhema Asala to have her behead him.')

edges.description: The Countess escapes the Dreadnought with the Beast after Jamanra severs the section holding it.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination' ('allowing the Countess to escape')

edges.description: The Beast is held in the Dreadnought and escapes once more with the Countess.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination' ('The Beast escapes with the Countess once more' / Jamanra severs the section holding the Beast)

edges.description: The Hooded One confesses to the Exile that he is Sin, the Thief of Virtue, and that he created the Beast.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest' (quote 'I am... a god. I am the Thief of Virtue. I am Sin.')

edges.description: The Hooded One's revealed identity is Sin, the Thief of Virtue.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest' (quote 'I am Sin.')

edges.description: Oswald, the treasure hunters' Quartermaster, greets the Exile at the Ziggurat camp.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Explore Ziggurat Encampment' (Oswald quote)

edges.description: Alva Valai introduces herself to the Exile at the Ziggurat Encampment.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Explore Ziggurat Encampment' (Alva quote)

edges.description: After the Chimera is defeated the Exile enters Jiquani's Machinarium.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Enter Jiquani's Machinarium'

edges.description: Xyclucian, the Chimera, is the guardian boss blocking the entrance to the Machinarium.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Defeat Xyclucian, the Chimera' ('A massive beast seems to be guarding the entrance')

edges.description: Alva asks the Exile to find a small Soul Core to power the stone door's mechanism.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Ask Alva for advice' / 'Search for a small Soul Core' (Alva quote)

edges.description: Zicoatl, Warden of the Core, is defeated to take the large Soul Core from the construct.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Defeat Zicoatl' / 'Pick up the Large Soul Core'

edges.description: Alva identifies the large Soul Core and advises which generators to activate.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' (Alva quote: 'This is the largest Soul Core I've ever seen!')

edges.description: The Exile powers the stone altar in the Infested Barrens with the large Soul Core.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Return to Infested Barrens and activate the Stone Altar'

edges.description: The Hooded One proposes lowering the lake using the Vaal canals.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Talk to the Hooded One' ('Ask the Hooded One about lowering the water level')

edges.description: Alva confirms the revealed city and sends the Exile to the Temple of Kopec's locked door.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Talk to Alva' (Alva quote about Kopec)

edges.description: The Queen of Filth is defeated in Aggorat and drops the Temple Door Idol.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Defeat the Queen of Filth' / 'Pick up the Temple Door Idol'

edges.description: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun, is defeated in the Temple of Kopec.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Defeat Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun'

edges.description: Alva deciphers the runes in the Temple and activates the elevator and gateway.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' (Alva quote: 'It.. worked!?')

edges.description: Alva accompanies the Exile through the time gateway and is seen as a threat by the Vaal.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Enter Utzaal in the past' (Alva quote: 'Are these... living Vaal?')

edges.description: Doryani is present as the gateway activates ('It begins...').

sources.locator: Quest log 'Enter Utzaal in the past' (Doryani quote)

edges.description: The Exile fights the Vaal forces of Utzaal's past.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Explore Utzaal in the past' ('Halt! Your rampage ends here!')

edges.description: Viper Napuatzi, the Vaal general, has Alva taken to Doryani and is defeated.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Explore Utzaal in the past' / 'Defeat Viper Napuatzi'

edges.description: Alva is seized by Viper Napuatzi's forces and must be rescued.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Defeat Viper Napuatzi' ('Take her! Bring her to Doryani!')

edges.description: The Exile fights through Aggorat to reach the Black Chambers.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Fight through Aggorat and search for the Black Chambers'

edges.description: Doryani, the Vaal expert on the Beast, is captured in the Black Chambers and agrees to help contain the Beast.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Capture Doryani for his knowledge of the Beast'

edges.description: Alva is rescued from the Black Chambers and persuades Doryani to come to the present.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Capture Doryani' (Alva quote: 'Help me-')

edges.description: The Exile and Alva survive the Cataclysm striking Utzaal in its past.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Survive the Cataclysm'

edges.description: Doryani returns through the gateway and laments that his people are long dead.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Doryani' (Doryani quote: 'Utzaal... my people... they're all long dead.')

edges.description: Alva survives the Cataclysm and returns through the gateway with the Exile.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' ('Oh good, you're alive!')

edges.description: Doryani confirms he holds one piece of the Precursor weapon and points the group to Ngamakanui.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Doryani' ('We must travel to the archipelago the Karui call Ngamakanui.')

edges.description: Alva proposes Kingsmarch as a base and offers a ship charter from her contact.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' / 'Travel to Kingsmarch'

edges.description: The Hooded One decides the group should travel south to Ngamakanui.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' ('If he thinks we should travel south to Ngamakanui, then so we shall.')
